title: Recovered craft not made by humanity, confirmed by AARO and the IG

tellings.quote: I am sure there are crafts that were not made by humanity at this current time and place when we recovered them.

plain: The United States has recovered craft that were not made by humanity, says Dylan Borland, a guest who tells Michels he is sure of it, adding that they were not made by humans 'at this current time and place', which leaves open other times or places. He links the claim to AARO, the Pentagon office set up to look into reports of unidentified objects, to the Inspector General, an internal government watchdog, and to a witness named David Grusch, and the story is framed as those bodies having confirmed it. If true, it would mean the government holds objects from somewhere other than present-day humanity.
